basis: Syndromic overgrowth with advanced skeletal maturation; hoarse cry alone does not establish airway damage, and an endocrine cause is not documented.
Acrorenal syndrome is defined by congenital limb and urinary tract abnormalities.
Cleft lip/palate, congenital heart defects and hearing loss define the syndrome; high myopia occurs in 6/7, with additional structural eye disease.
Cobalamin metabolic defect with megaloblastic anemia and neurodevelopmental impairment; cardiac anomalies reported in 30-79%; stomatitis 4/12 omitted by cap.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis. Metastatic disease is not intrinsic organ involvement for this concept.
Phosphatidylcholine biosynthesis defect causes muscular dystrophy; intellectual disability in 15/15 and dilated cardiomyopathy in 6/13.
Defined as disease involving the small intestine; no additional organ involvement applies across this umbrella.
CIC-rearranged sarcoma usually arises in deep soft tissues of the trunk or limbs; no additional organ damage is intrinsic to the diagnosis.
Rupture of an intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile duct; both are within the hepatic axis.
Benign persistent polyclonal B-cell proliferation in blood; neither lymphoma nor established immune deficiency. Mild splenomegaly remains within the blood axis.
Urothelial carcinoma arising in the bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with seizures, developmental impairment and structural brain abnormalities.
Neurodegeneration of the cerebellum, pons and inferior olives.
TUBB2B-related cortical and other brain malformations cause developmental impairment; ocular abnormalities are occasional, below 30%.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; cerebellar atrophy/ataxia in 3/3 and axonal neuropathy in 2/2. Hepatic, retinal and hearing damage lack established >=30% frequency.
Mitochondrial energy-metabolism disorder causing ocular skeletal myopathy, ptosis and ophthalmoplegia; hearing loss in 4/20 is below threshold.
Inherited glomerular disease with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis and steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome; no immune mechanism established.
Inherited blistering and poikiloderma; gingivitis and premature tooth loss occur in 80-99%, supporting oral involvement. Corneal disease is only occasional.
Fetal B19 infection damages erythroid precursors; anemia and thrombocytopenia occur in 80-99%. Cardiomyopathy and ocular abnormalities occur in only 5-29%.
Connective-tissue neoplasm umbrella includes bone, cartilage and fibrous tissue tumors; histologic composition does not establish additional organ sites.
Inherited atrial cardiomyopathy with loss of atrial electrical and mechanical activity; stroke is a separate embolic complication.
Benign tumor arising in eyelid epidermis; both skin and eyelid are explicitly represented by the axes.
Pancreatic hypoplasia causes diabetes and exocrine insufficiency with congenital heart disease; developmental delay in 7/15. Diaphragm defects omitted by cap.
Absence of menstruation is a reproductive disorder; this umbrella does not establish a specific endocrine disease.
Inherited metabolic bone-remodeling/proteostasis disorder with osteolysis and sclerosis; hearing impairment occurs in only 5-29%.
